agent.context: This devbox holds the Vercel CLI monorepo (github.com/vercel/vercel), cloned at `~/vercel` — the primary clone where `devbox build` ran. It's a pnpm + turbo monorepo with TypeScript packages under `packages/`, Rust crates under `crates/`, and Python packages under `python/`. Read `~/vercel/AGENTS.md` first for conventions: pnpm for installs, turbo for builds, and biome for formatting. Common commands: `pnpm install`, `pnpm build`, `pnpm type-check`, `pnpm test-unit`, and package-scoped work via `cd packages/<name>`.
